name: Admin Panel
description: Full admin dashboard with data tables, charts, settings, and user management

frontend.name: 01_header.txt
frontend.content: Create an admin panel header with logo, breadcrumbs, notifications bell, user menu. Include a dark sidebar toggle button.

frontend.name: 02_sidebar.txt
frontend.content: Create a dark sidebar with: Overview, Users, Roles, Content, Analytics, Reports, Settings. Highlight the active item.

frontend.name: 03_data_table.txt
frontend.content: Create a fully-featured data table with server-side pagination, sorting, search/filter, row selection checkboxes, and action buttons (Edit/Delete). Use vanilla JS.

frontend.name: 04_charts.txt
frontend.content: Create 3 chart cards using Chart.js: User Growth (line), Revenue by Category (doughnut), Activity Overview (bar). Each in its own card with a title.

frontend.name: 05_user_form.txt
frontend.content: Create a modal user form with fields: Name, Email, Role (dropdown), Status (toggle), Avatar upload. Include form validation and a preview.

frontend.name: 06_footer.txt
frontend.content: Create a footer with pagination info, action buttons (Delete Selected, Export), and a timestamp.

backend.name: 01_server.txt
backend.content: Create an Express.js server with express-validator, CORS, and helmet. Add routes: /api/users, /api/roles, /api/content, /api/analytics.

backend.name: 02_database.txt
backend.content: Create a PostgreSQL/MySQL schema for admin panel: users, roles, permissions, content, audit_logs. Include role-based access control tables.

backend.name: 03_routes.txt
backend.content: Create REST API routes for users: GET /api/users (with pagination+search), POST /api/users, PUT /api/users/:id, DELETE /api/users/:id. Include role assignment sub-routes.

backend.name: 04_auth.txt
backend.content: Add JWT-based RBAC auth: login, register, role-check middleware. Generate tokens with 7-day expiry. Include refresh token endpoint.
